chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Trumpet players who push themselves: Freddy Webster, Shavers, Eldridge
summary: Some good trumpeters never promote themselves, unlike Charlie Shavers and Roy Eldridge, who stayed in the spotlight.
